parsed.summary: The change introduces a micro-optimization by avoiding the instantiation of MaxLengthValidator when max_length is None. It also aligns with the approach used in BinaryField.

issues.description: The change introduces a minor style inconsistency by adding an if condition to append validators, which is different from the existing pattern in the codebase.
